lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly 10 visible vertical columns along the lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the upper margin and shadows on the lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin features roughly 12-15 high-luminance blobs of varying sizes distributed across the visible lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of micro-spots is visible on the cranial region anterior to the gills, exhibiting a much higher spatial frequency than the spots on the trunk.
